description: Wind Chime Matte Ivory is a high-end contemporary fabric from S. Harris, featuring an exclusive pattern. It is made of 100% linen and is suitable for bedding, drapery, and multipurpose uses. The fabric is reversible and dry clean only, with a large scale abstract print pattern.

The fabric is reversible and dry clean only, with a large scale abstract design in linen and off white/ivory colors. It exceeds 51,000 double rubs, ensuring durability.

name: Adrian Ottoman
description: A versatile piece perfect for propping up your feet, extra seating, or even as a chic coffee table alternative, adding a touch of cozy luxury and playful style to any room!

name: Aimee Bed
description: Our Aimee Bed offers a simple silhouette with a low profile. Available upholstered or slipcovered to suit your style.

name: Amelie Armless Dining Chair
description: The Amelie Armless Dining Chair exudes elegance with its sleek, high back, gracefully contoured silhouette, and perfectly cushioned seat, offering a sophisticated and comfortable dining experience.

name: Amelie Banquette
description: An extended version of the Amelie Dining Chair, the Amelie Banquette captivates with its high, gracefully curved backrest, elegant winged sides, and inviting seat.

name: Amelie Corner Banquette
description: The Amelie Corner Banquette is a sophisticated piece of furniture designed for comfort and style. It features a variety of size options and is available in curated fabric and leather collections. Enhance your piece with in-house water-based finishes, offering unique variations in color and grain.
color: Varies with fabric and leather selection

name: Arthur Rocker
description: The Arthur Rocker blends modern elegance with organic flow. Its tight seat and back offer a tailored, clean profile, while the chair's gentle rocking motion and durable construction make it both a stylish and functional statement piece. Available with carefully sculpted exposed wood arms in an open-frame design or a minimalist armless design featuring a solid hardwood rocking base.

name: Brisbane Coffee Table
description: The Brisbane Coffee Table is part of an architectural series where vertical and horizontal planes, voids and solids have a rhythmic and playful conversation.

name: Brisbane Console
description: The Brisbane Console is part of an architectural series where vertical and horizontal planes, voids and solids have a rhythmic and playful conversation.

name: Brisbane Desk
description: The Brisbane Desk is part of an architectural series where vertical and horizontal planes, voids and solids have a rhythmic and playful conversation.

name: Brisbane Side Table
description: An architectural side table where vertical and horizontal planes, voids and solids have a rhythmic and playful conversation. Available in Ash or Walnut, round or rectangle.

name: Charlie Bench
description: Meet the Charlie Bench, a sleek, modern piece with a plush, inviting seat and clean lines that make it perfect for adding a touch of contemporary fun and versatile seating to any room.

name: Charlotte Chair
description: Our classic piece that gains elegance and relevance with a new minimal base.

name: Charlotte Swivel Club Chair
description: The Charlotte Swivel Club Chair is characterized by its classic armrest, minimal swivel base, and tight seat and back configuration.

name: Chloe Chaise
description: The Chloe Chaise carries the same playful curves and slightly angled arm as the sofa, offering a unique silhouette. With its plush, tight seat and back, this chaise combines bold, modern design with luxurious comfort, making it a perfect statement piece for lounging in style.

name: Como Floor Lamp
description: A beautifully curved wooden base and a chic fabric shade, perfect for adding a touch of modern sophistication and warm ambiance to any room!
color: natural variations in color, grain, and banding

name: Como Table Lamp
description: A beautifully curved wooden base and a chic fabric shade, perfect for adding a touch of modern sophistication and warm ambiance to any room!
color: natural variations in color, grain, and banding

name: Cosmo Club Chair
description: The Cosmo Chair features a modern, sculpted design with a generously supportive yet soft back and seat, all supported by a sleek, solid wooden frame.

name: Courtney Rocker
description: The Courtney Rocker features gracefully sloped arms, a supportive high back, and a loose seat cushion, all mounted on elegant wooden rockers.
color: Unique variations due to natural characteristics

name: Crew Bed
description: The Crew Bed is available in various sizes with options for low or tall headboards. It features a sturdy construction and is part of Verellen's curated collection. The bed is designed to offer both style and comfort, with a range of fabric options available for upholstery.

name: Crew Sectional
description: The Crew Sectional extends an invitation to unwind, with modular pieces that wrap you in comfort. Thoughtfully designed with divided backs and soft, generous proportions, each configuration offers a relaxed elegance that adapts effortlessly to your space. From intimate corners to expansive lounges, Crew brings warmth, harmony, and effortless style to every setting.

name: Ella Bed
description: Our Ella Bed stars elegantly in shape with tailored details and a grounded repetitive base.

name: Ella Ottoman
description: Our Ella Ottoman stars elegantly in shape, with tailored details.
color: Natural variations in color and markings due to leather and hardwood characteristics.

name: Ella Sectional
description: Our Ella Sectional stars elegantly in shape, with tailored details and a grounded repetitive base.

name: Ella Swivel Chair
description: Our Ella Swivel Chair stars elegantly in shape, with tailored details and a grounded repetitive base.

name: Bliss
description: The organically abstract allover design evokes a range of associations – shimmering water droplets, the veining of a rare gemstone, or the coat of a wildcat – fluid, layered, and naturally elegant. Varying pile heights capture the light and transform it into soft tonal gradations. The result is a surface that shimmers differently from every angle – sometimes with a silky glow, sometimes with gentle depth. Available in twelve colorways, from radiant and fresh to deep and sophisticated, BLISS reveals itself as a velvet of shimmering refinement – a fabric that captures the fleeting beauty of a moment.

name: Cedro
description: This decorative upholstery fabric unfolds its character in a delicate balance of movement and calm. The marbled jacquard weave features a tone-on-tone pattern whose lines glide across the surface like flowing water. The interplay of voluminous bouclé yarn and a matte satin base creates a subtle relief structure that gently shapes the woven surface. Fine contour lines accentuate the moiré-like texture of the motif, bringing the visual relief clearly to life.

name: Loggia
description: LOGGIA plays with the idea of woven structure – clean, graphic, yet naturally appealing. With its impressive depth and embossed relief effect, the surface recalls handcrafted raffia weaving. The material demonstrates how effortlessly function and style can come together: easy to maintain, lightfast, and washable, while exuding cool elegance and tactile presence. Whether in a subtly designed salon interior or an airy spa environment, LOGGIA fits seamlessly into a wide range of settings thanks to its excellent care and performance properties. The woven look feels both modern and timeless – an upholstery fabric with architectural character that gracefully blurs the boundaries between indoors and out.

name: Rythm Delight
description: Rythm Delight is an upholstery fabric that captivates with its fascinating interplay of sheen and texture. On an elegant satin ground unfolds a delicate allover texture of matte bouclé yarn, giving the fabric depth and vibrancy. The jacquard pattern appears almost like a relief – subtle yet expressive – creating a harmonious tension between lustrous elegance and soft matte finish. Whether on a single chair or expansive upholstered surfaces, the fabric transforms every piece into a stylish statement. RYTHM DELIGHT plays charmingly with light and shadow, lending interiors a refined, distinctive presence that feels both understated and remarkable.

name: Infinity Tweed
description: This upholstery fabric combines the grace of traditional craftsmanship with contemporary functionality. The multicolored structured flat weave evokes a lively tweed, enhanced by subtle bouclé accents that lend the surface a slightly irregular, organic texture. Coarse and fine yarns create a harmonious play of color, giving each piece of furniture its own distinctive character. Beneath its natural appearance lies a sophisticated high-tech composition: easy to care for, durable, and pleasantly soft to the touch, this fabric perfectly balances aesthetics and everyday practicality. Whether used to upholster chairs, sofas, or casual cushion arrangements, the fabric conveys the warmth of handcrafted materials while meeting modern standards. INFINITY TWEED is produced in Germany in a climate-neutral process using European-sourced yarns.

name: Infinity Raya
description: Infinity Raya is a contemporary interpretation of the classic stripe motif. Velour ribs with a fine high-low effect lend the surface of this upholstery fabric a three-dimensional depth, its contours accentuated by delicate, color-contrasting lines. The fabric combines comfort, easy care, and durability, offering excellent functional properties. It is washable, easy to clean, features outstanding lightfastness, and is suitable for allergy sufferers. Produced in Germany using European-sourced yarns, it is part of the INFINITY product family.

name: Bamboo
description: Generous block stripes rest like artfully strung pearl bands upon a densely woven satin warp. The brocade-woven stripe motifs capture the light, creating a decorative interplay of matte and sheen. The fabric’s sumptuous, fluid drape lends this extravagant decorative textile a sense of luxurious opulence that enriches windows and interiors with atmosphere and depth. Whether used as a curtain, room divider, or wall covering, BAMBOO unites refined textile tradition with a feeling of modern luxury.

name: Lucky Charm
description: Inspired by the tranquility and beauty of Asian water landscapes, Lucky Charm features cranes, symbols of happiness and longevity in Asian culture, gliding gracefully through a freshly blossoming spring scene. Flowers and leaves glow in the clear light that follows a refreshing rain shower. Crafted in the finest jacquard technique, the expansive design reveals its charm through intricate detail and luminous, refined coloration.

name: Mato
description: MATO reveals its charm through subtle nuances. On a delicately shimmering ground, horizontal lines appear like a fine mesh laid across the surface, gently accentuating the play of color. The base gains its vitality from the slight sheen of the floating warp yarns, which create a lively wave-like texture on the surface. Every movement, every shift of light unveils new facets of this finely woven jacquard, enhancing the impact of its fourteen elegant colorways. Here, minimalism becomes a sensory experience — a fabric for connoisseurs who appreciate refined details and sophisticated materiality.

name: Iriza
description: Iriza is a floor-to-ceiling taffeta fabric that impresses with its firm structure and shimmering luster. Its densely woven quality gives the textile its distinctive taffeta body, allowing for a dramatic drape that unfolds its full effect, especially in generous curtains. The extensive palette of 30 sophisticated colorways captivates with refined, iridescent nuances created through the interplay of warp and weft threads. IRIZA unites understated elegance with sculptural presence.

name: Ishari
description: This floor-to-ceiling drapery fabric celebrates the quiet beauty of restraint. Two ultra-fine woven layers encase loosely bound effect yarns whose subtle bouclé character lends the surface a gentle vitality. The result is a textile balance between openness and structure, transparency and volume. The color palette features exclusively neutral natural tones that integrate effortlessly into a wide range of interior concepts. With its easy-care properties and understated appearance, ISHARI becomes a timeless companion for contemporary interiors.

name: Chaconia
description: The generously scaled Scherli design unfurls in gentle movement across the transparent ground — a weave of leaves, branches, and grape-like blossoms that reveal their full allure in backlight. The refined balance between dense and translucent areas creates a delicate interplay of light and shadow, lending the room a poetic atmosphere. Subtly metallic accents within the blossoms add shimmering highlights and give the design a modern, luxurious touch. A decorative fabric that artfully blurs the line between indoors and outdoors, between natural beauty and refined elegance.
material: 41% Flax (linen), 29% Cotton, 19% Polyester, 5% Viscose, 4% Acrylic, 2% Polyamide

name: Nuri
description: Nuri is a subtle fabric that fills interiors with an authentic sense of character. This floor-to-ceiling check weave plays with the contrast between transparency and density, creating a textile graphic of great calm and precision. Yarns of varying thickness and differing weave densities form a fine grid reminiscent of the crosshatching in a drawing — lively, natural, and uncontrived. The gentle irregularity of the effect yarns gives the fabric its distinctive signature: an engaging interplay of line and surface, craftsmanship and lightness.

name: Silvan
description: This embroidered sheer fabric captures the charm of effortless ease. Organic lines flow across the airy ground, stitched tone-on-tone in a rhythmic zigzag pattern — sometimes dense, sometimes freely meandering. The result is a lively allover design reminiscent of handcrafted embroidery, giving the textile a charming artisanal touch. A modern classic infused with a sense of lightness and the feeling of a summer breeze within the room.
material: Embroidery: 60% Polyester, 25% Cotton, 15% Flax (linen); Ground: 53% Flax (linen), 28% Cotton, 19% Polyester

name: Niket
description: A fabric that captivates through its effortless naturalness. The semi-transparent grid weave, crafted in a classic leno technique, reveals an open structure and a pleasantly fluid drape. A special, gentle finish gives the textile its characteristic volume and natural irregularity — almost as if it were handmade. The look is deliberately understated, exuding a calm, relaxed elegance that lends any room a subtle warmth. Made from high-quality polyester yarns, NIKET combines authentic natural appeal with easy care and modern everyday practicality.

name: Hidcote Indienne
description: ‘Hidcote Indienne’ is inspired by the gardens of Hidcote Manor, a 10.5-acre stretch of formal gardens designed by American horticulturalist Lawrence Johnston in the early 20th century. The planting style at Hidcote is diverse, inspired by Johnston’s travels across Africa Asia and his love of the Arts and Crafts movement. The design includes the likeness of the pink ‘Lawrence Johnston’ placed throughout the design.

name: Pampelonne
description: Pampelonne is a double width, open-weave voile fabric made from 100% linen. The yarn supplier, based in Belgium, are certified Masters of Linen as well as being European-Flax and Oeko-Tex-certified. The long linen fibers guarantee robust quality. The fabric is woven in a traditional textile mill in France, 20 minutes away from our design studio. The fabric is piece-dyed and then stabilized with a gentle stone-wash finish, ensuring softness and a distinctive touch.

name: Beloha
description: Beloha is a wide-width, striped fabric made of Oeko-Tex and GOTS-certified linen and cotton. The beauty of linen paired with the softness of cotton imbues Beloha with charm and naturalness. The finish is as soft as absorbent cotton.

name: Nazca
description: Nazca is a wide-width fabric boasting Cornely embroidery. It’s a yarn-dyed cloth made of pure linen, certified according to GOTS standards. A stone-wash finish provides the material with a beautiful texture and structure.

name: Nagpur
description: Nagpur is a homage to Berber carpets. The traditional craftsman's weaving mill, based in Belgium, is a certified Master of Linen as well as being European-Flax and Oeko-Tex-certified. The luxury weft yarn is spun in the tradition of haute-couture tweed. The exclusive color spectrum and nuances create a product with the soft blend of half-tones. The 'washed and tumbled' finish provides a natural handle and softness with a woolen texture. This fabric achieves an 80,000 Martindale.

name: Asni
description: Asni’s inspiration comes from striped Berber carpets. Here, the stripe is woven through the weft as a broad block of color. The traditional craftsman's weaving mill, based in Belgium, is a certified Master of Linen as well as being European-Flax and Oeko-Tex-certified. The high quality linen used in this fabric, is a testament to the traditional hand loom heritage from South of France. The "washed and tumbled" finish provides softness and a natural handle for modern interiors and large windows that open out onto nature.

name: Noga
description: Noga plays with transparencies and is inspired by traditional basket weaving. The fabric is made from high-quality linen, a testament to the traditional hand loom heritage from South of France. It features a 'washed and tumbled' finish for softness and a natural handle, suitable for modern interiors and large windows. The weaving mill is based in Belgium and is a certified Master of Linen, European-Flax, and Oeko-Tex-certified.

name: Andria
description: Andria is a broad-striped woven fabric from Italy made from cotton and linen. This beautiful fabric combines a variety of selected yarns with the 'Maltinto' artisanal dyeing process, giving the pretty stripe a vintage patina.

name: Licata
description: Licata is as filigree as linen lace. So much expertise and passion comes from the Italian craftsmanship, ensuring this sophisticated fabric is created. Licata is woven on treasured Dornier jacquard weaving looms. The warp threads are from 100% European-Flax-certified linen. All the steps in the process, from spinning the yarn to weaving right down to the finishing, are carried out in Italy. Kuralon – a special resin – enables the craftspeople to weave threads that would otherwise be too fine to weave. The resin dissolves during finishing so that only the ultra-fine linen threads remain. An artistic 'basket tumbler' finish gives the soft linen voile a delicate drape and cashmere-like feel.

name: Teatro Wall Light
description: The Teatro wall light captures the elegance and drama of Roman palazzos and theatres, designed in collaboration with the artist Gergei Erdei. Inspired by the folds of heavy curtains, its hand-sculpted design creates a striking three-dimensional form, gently curving away from the surface of the wall to create an impactful silhouette. Each piece is individually handcrafted from a prototype originally draped from fabric, preserving the artistry of its creation. Subtle imperfections in the surface texture reflect the hand of the maker. Suited to both classic and contemporary interiors. Available in Anziano White or Gilted Verdigris — new finishes developed with Erdei to emphasise the unique draped form.

name: Etrusco Lamp
description: Designed in collaboration with artist Gergei Erdei, the Etrusco lamp pays homage to ancient Roman amphoras while referencing the symmetry of Art Deco design. The sculpted base features distinctive details, elevated on a sleek hand-forged and textured pedestal for added presence. Handcrafted and balanced in proportion, the Etrusco serves as both functional lighting and artistic centrepiece, offering a refined fusion of past and present. Available in Anziano White and Distressed Gold or New Bronze and Distressed Gold.

name: Scallop Wall Light Small
description: Since its launch in 2013 the Scallop Shell wall light has transformed bathrooms, kitchens and many other spaces due to its scale and proportion, the versatility of its finishes and the soft light it emits. To extend its influence, we have now created a smaller, more jewel-like scale. Cast in-house and finished by hand in our studio. Available in any painted finish of your choice.

name: Mini Bianca Lamp
description: The Mini Bianca is a compact and striking table lamp with a softly faceted, mineral-inspired silhouette. Dual-tone, metal-like finishes are expertly layered by hand in our painting studio to create a tactile patina.
color: Dark King Copper and King Copper

name: Dorian Lamp
description: The Dorian table lamp balances a grounded presence with an asymmetrical profile that echoes 1940s sculpture. Sharing its design language with the Lucian lamp to create a juxtaposing pair. Cast in composite and hand‑finished in our painting studio.

name: Twisted Compton Ceiling Light
description: The Twisted Compton ceiling light adds sinuous rhythm to the original’s sculptural simplicity. Locally forged then hand-finished in our painting studio, it brings movement and texture to contemporary interiors.

name: Origami Lamp
description: The Origami table lamp takes inspiration from folded paper forms. Sculpted in-house and cast in composite, its angular planes are enhanced with a hand-painted finish of your choice.

name: Dali Lamp
description: The Dali table lamp pays homage to the Parisian avant‑garde. Hand‑forged in mild steel by a skilled local metalsmith, its subtly dimpled surface is finished by hand in our painting studio to create a rich, well‑worn patina.

name: Lila Wall Light
description: The Lila wall light brings the serene beauty of aquatic flora to vertical planes. Hand-sculpted lily pads curve from the wall, catching light in their folds like petals at dusk. Hand-painted finishes introduce gentle texture. Also available as a ceiling light.

name: Lucian Lamp
description: The Lucian table lamp features a twisting, root‑like base drawn from organic forms and Mexican architecture. Sharing its design language with the Dorian lamp to create a juxtaposing pair. Sculpted in‑house, cast in composite and hand‑finished in our painting studio.

name: Julius Wall Light
description: The Julius wall light is sculpted and cast in-house, then hand-decorated to emphasise its dimpled texture. Finished with a hand-painted gold interior to create a soft and luminous reflection.

name: Lila Ceiling Light
description: The Lila ceiling light is inspired by lily pads and flowers, capturing the serene beauty of aquatic flora. Hand‑painted finishes introduce gentle texture. A tiny frog perches delicately on one of the leaves. Also available as a wall light.

name: Camelio Wall Light
description: The flowing lines of a seashell inspired the Camelio wall light’s elegant form. Hand-cast and finished with a coarse, stone-like painted finish — Burnt Stone — developed specifically for the piece, it casts a soft, upward glow that enhances intimate spaces. Also available in Sprottle or any painted finish of your choice.

name: Helix Ceiling Light
description: The Helix sculptural ceiling light is both kinetic and calming. Shaped in steel by a skilled local metalsmith. Textured and hand‑decorated in a painted finish of your choice — the form casts soft, swirling shadows. A work of art suspended in space.

name: Hecate Ceiling Light
description: The Hecate ceiling light is a bold statement inspired by Greek mythology. A monolithic assembly of welded steel arms with offset angles creates a distinctive silhouette. Hand‑forged in Britain and decorated by hand in our painting studio.

name: Briar Lamp
description: The Briar is a handblown glass table lamp inspired by mid-century glassmaking and organic form. Crafted in collaboration with one of our British artisan glassblowers, each piece is unique with layered glass peaks. Available in Clear, Amber, Lemongrass or Denim.

name: Mollusc Wall Light
description: The Mollusc wall light features a gently undulating, hand‑cast form inspired by our Rupi family. A new Autumn Gold painted finish enriches the outer surface, paired with a Bright Gold interior to create a warm, uplifting glow.

name: Cannella Floor Lamp
description: The Cannella is a refined, architectural floor lamp with a clean vertical silhouette. Fabricated in-house and hand-finished with a Bright Gold inner detailing to reflect a warm, soft glow.
color: Light New Bronze and Bright Gold

name: Connie Wall Light Uplight
description: The Connie wall light, shaped like a bell, and in the style of a campaign tent, is hand-cast and then textured and hand-painted. Available in two orientations. Also available as a pendant light and in any custom painted finish.

name: Barnacle Lamp
description: The Barnacle lamp has a heavy, low, round design and a unique personality due to the individual, sculpted ‘barnacle’ elements each hand-applied, adding to its texture and character. Available in glazes including Almond, Capri, Pudding, Safari or Tigers Eye. It has the feel of something old and interesting, looking at it more closely you notice how much depth there is to each finish.

name: Finley Ceramic Lamp
description: One of the most exciting designs from the Autumn 24 collection, Finley — a large-scale hand-cast table lamp inspired by the abstract shape of a cactus with rippled, asymmetrical fins on all sides. Now available in Crème Brulée and Safari glazes, it somehow seems even more spectacular.

name: Scallop Ceramic Wall Light Small
description: Since its launch in 2013 the Scallop Shell wall light has transformed bathrooms, kitchens and many other spaces due to its scale and proportion, the versatility of its finishes and the soft light it emits. To extend its influence, we have now created a smaller, more jewel-like scale in ceramic available in a series of different glazes. Capri and Myrtle are strong and eye-catching, while more neutral colours such as Safari give it tremendous scope for versatility.
lead_time: Please contact sales@portaromana.com for lead time information

name: Bolla Wall Light
description: The Bolla Wall Light is a reinterpretation of the Boublé table lamp, inspired by the work of Georges Jouve. It is part of the Porta Romana collection for Spring 25 and is available in a range of irresistible glazes including Safari, Pudding, Almond, or Myrtle. This product is UL listed.

name: Rupi Ceramic Wall Light Small
description: Inspired by the Pinea Trees that guard the southern Italian coastline, the Rupi wall light is sculpted, with textured branches and an undulating, curved up light. Now available in ceramic, glazed in Almond, Myrtle and Pudding, changing the character completely. The Rupi ceramic wall light is available in Large and Small.
lead_time: Please contact sales@portaromana.com for lead time information

name: Bouquet
description: A beautiful décor designed after a historic Rijksmuseum tapestry, presented on a slightly textured textile with an airy, open weave. The design comes to life on a slightly textured textile, whose airy, open weave lends the composition a calming and natural appearance.

name: Ramage
description: In the world of textile design, a ramage denotes a motif of branches and flowers—an apt name for this décor in a Japanese drawing style, where birds of paradise hide playfully among lush foliage. The luxurious jacquard textile lends the composition a classical, enduring elegance.

name: Brocade
description: The Brocade décor is derived from an early 20th century textile. Its refined motif, rich in detail and texture, is revived on a luxurious jacquard fabric, preserving the grandeur and elegance of the original pattern.

name: Bucolique
description: Bucolique is designed after a 17th-century tapestry, depicting an idyllic scene in which two elegant swans take centre stage. The panoramic composition is rendered on a richly textured textile, giving it the tactile presence and depth of an authentic wall tapestry.

name: Escapade
description: The Escapade panorama, designed after a late-18th-century tapestry, evokes the atmosphere of a painted scene. It reveals a dreamy natural landscape that invites the viewer to wander and drift away, while the velvety-soft textile heightens the sense of luxury and elegance.

name: Floraison
description: With its ornate frame, Floraison recalls the character of a classical painting. It is designed after an original 18th-century tapestry from Aubusson, and the composition draws the viewer almost irresistibly into the scene. The panorama is executed on a parchment-like base, emphasising the authentic origin of the drawing.

name: Récolte des Fleurs
description: The Récolte des Fleurs panorama, designed after an antique Beauvais tapestry, depicts a lively and joyful scene. The flower pickers celebrate life with an infectious energy that seems to radiate from the design. Rendered on a parchment-like base, the work glows like a precious artefact that has gracefully withstood the test of time.

name: Ornement
description: The abstract floral richness of the Ornement décor captivates through its exceptional cross-stitch embroidery. This rendering of an 18th-century tapestry is revitalised on a luxurious, ultra-soft velour, adding depth and tactile allure to the design.

name: Collines
description: The Collines décor is derived from an authentic 18th-century tapestry from Aubusson. Its abstract botanical motif is distinctly timeless, making it perfectly suited to contemporary interiors while preserving the charm of its historic origins.

name: Riverbank
description: Inspired by classic tapestries, this woven jacquard wallcovering depicts a lush riverbank with a Japanese crane peeking out of the vegetation. This unique species symbolises good luck and longevity in Japan. The drawing is intentionally pixelated in a nod to the country's mid-century optimism.

name: Kashmir
description: Kashmir is a panoramic design inspired by the colourful shawls of India, printed on a vinyl base with the texture of evenly woven linen.

name: Kerala
description: The swaying palms along the riverbanks of the Indian state of Kerala inspired this panoramic design. Its graceful lines stand out beautifully on the vinyl base, which has the relaxed, open-woven texture of linen.

name: Bundi
description: This plain design offers a remarkably realistic interpretation of timeless linen, with an exceptionally matte vinyl finish. Its even weave creates a calm, balanced effect. Bundi, named after the charming Indian town, is available in a rich palette of warm, natural colours.

name: Mandu
description: Named after the historic Indian city of Mandu, this understated design is a vinyl with the elegant, airy look of handwoven linen. Its open weave reveals subtle irregularities, highlighting its artisanal character. Mandu is available in a beautiful palette of warm, natural colours.

name: Agra
description: Agra is an abstract flower design printed on an elegant vinyl base that mimics the texture of handwoven linen. It draws inspiration from the flowering plants that color the landscape in spring, as well as the floral garlands found in countless street stalls.

name: Poona
description: This airy design is named after the Indian city of Pune, formerly Poona, home to the magnificent Aga Khan Palace. Poona draws inspiration from the palace’s graceful arches and is printed on a vinyl base with a realistic, evenly woven linen texture.

name: Ibis
description: The Ibis design features tall panels depicting the verdant green riverbanks of the Nile, rendered in a soft relief textile. Among the lush foliage, the graceful ibis - a bird rich in ancient Egyptian symbolism - occasionally appears, adding a poetic touch to the design.

name: Abydos
description: This intriguing geometric pattern, Abydos, is composed of strong lines moving in different directions, inspired by the characteristic structures of the temples of Abydos, one of Egypt’s oldest and most spiritual cities. The soft 3D textile amplifies the dynamic effect, truly bringing the design to life.

name: Siwa
description: The Siwa design draws inspiration from the distinctive texture of the palm trunk, subtly referencing the remarkable trees that symbolize life in the desert. This design exudes warmth thanks to the soft, tactile relief textile.

name: Sakkara
description: Sakkara takes its name from the necropolis near Memphis, world-famous for its many pyramids, including Pharaoh Djoser’s iconic step pyramid. This pattern is inspired by the breathtaking desert landscape and evokes the architectural rhythm of the pyramids through layered structures and rectangular forms. The velvety 3D textile gives the design a remarkably vibrant presence.

name: Amarna
description: Amarna is a rich and lively design, loosely inspired by the organic layout of a bustling city. Named after the ancient Egyptian city surrounded by fertile valleys on the eastern bank of the Nile, it is crafted in a soft, luxurious 3D textile that enhances its dynamic, vibrant feel.

name: Avra
description: An aura, or ‘avra’ in Greek, is an invisible atmosphere or a feeling surrounding a person, place, or object. This design captures that very essence, with an aura-like effect that seems to float around the drawing. Printed onto a fine fil à fil textile, it uses a generous application of ink to create a design that seems to hover gently on the surface, resulting in an enchanting effect.
